official_measurement_examples.name: Approved Document E scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document E provides Building Regulations guidance for resistance to the passage of sound in dwelling-houses, flats, rooms for residential purposes and schools.

official_measurement_examples.name: Pre-completion testing framework
official_measurement_examples.fact: Government circular 03/2002 introduced the statutory framework for pre-completion sound insulation testing and building-control selection of test samples.

official_measurement_examples.name: Test-result evidence
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved sound-insulation test procedures produce construction-specific evidence for Building Regulations compliance and do not determine the planning merits of the development.

official_measurement_examples.name: Robust Details alternative
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2004 amendments introduced an approved Robust Details route as an alternative to pre-completion testing for eligible new dwellings where the statutory conditions are satisfied.

official_measurement_examples.name: Material change of use
official_measurement_examples.fact: Part E can apply when a building undergoes a specified material change of use creating dwellings or rooms for residential purposes; the change of use itself is not evidence that the acoustic requirements have been met.

official_measurement_examples.name: BB93 school role
official_measurement_examples.fact: Building Bulletin 93 gives acoustic performance standards and guidance for school buildings and supports the school-acoustics provisions referenced by Approved Document E.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 DfE bulletin collection
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Department for Education published its design guidance and building bulletins collection on 11 February 2026, including BB93 among the current school-design resources.

official_measurement_examples.name: Site-specific testing scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: A site-specific sound insulation test report demonstrates the tested construction's performance and is not by itself planning permission or a general environmental-noise clearance for the site.
